identity_note: All fixture IDs are opaque exact test coordinates. They are not canonical Clause hashes or admitted identities.

rules.spelling: local Designation spelling only; U+002F slash is forbidden
rules.namespace_resolution: exact NamespaceId only; never infer namespace, kind, role, or path from spelling or hyphen segments
rules.referent_identity: exact opaque ReferentId only; spelling and binding order never derive identity; shared ReferentId requires explicit semantic_continuity evidence
rules.role_designations: each context Role designation binds one exact schema-scoped RoleId and reuses only the ReferentId of its explicitly cited semantic-package role binding
rules.origin: source paths, prior spellings, JSON Pointers, and occurrence counts are nonconstitutive SourceMap/fixture evidence and may contain slash
